chunks: How many a habitation given to wickedness have We destroyed, whose roofs tumbled down, which fell into ruins. How many a well and fortress reinforced lie abandoned!

key_terms.خَاوِيَةٌ: lying in ruins or hollowed out

ai.seo_question: What are the signs of the destroyed communities mentioned in Surah Al-Hajj?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Hajj serves as a potent reminder of divine retribution against tyrannical regimes, emphasizing that material grandeur, symbolized by 'sturdy fortresses,' cannot shield oppressors from God's justice. The imagery of abandoned wells and collapsed roofs underscores the transience of worldly power when divorced from moral integrity, a theme frequently cited by Imams to illustrate the inevitable fall of unjust rulers.
